text: dsh-subagent-marker 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面插件，用于辨认当前输入框属于子代理会话还是主会话。它通过客户端模块注册在对话输入区右侧的控制槽位，并读取当前会话快照中的 subagent 状态；当会话属于子代理时，输入框工具行会显示 subagent 标记，主会话则不添加标记。插件包含 Host 加载入口和浏览器端界面模块，安装后由 DSH 的插件加载配置挂载。它适合经常在主会话和子代理会话间切换、希望减少向错误会话输入内容的用户。插件代码未声明 API 密钥、账号或外部服务配置。

dsh-subagent-marker is a DSH Web UI plugin that labels subagent sessions. It registers in the conversation composer's right-side control slot and reads the session snapshot. Subagent sessions show a marker; root sessions show nothing. It needs no API key, account, or external service.
想一眼看出当前输入框是不是子代理会话。
DSH 能不能给子代理的输入区加个身份提示？
Show me whether I'm typing in a subagent session.
dsh-subagent-marker 的功能「子代理会话标记」：在对话输入框右侧工具区显示 subagent 标签，帮助识别当前会话。插件读取会话快照中的 subagent 状态，仅在子代理会话中渲染；主会话不增加界面节点。
dsh-subagent-marker 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 11 天；提交数 7；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-subagent-marker README · dsh-subagent-marker：**给 DeepSeek Harness 子代理会话的输入框加标识。**

沟槽的 dsh UI 设计，一晚上好几次在查看 subagent 内容之后误输入 prompt 给 subagent，浪费数百 K token，一怒之下遂跑了这么个插件。

只加了个标签，其他什么都没干。大概不会影响其他插件。

[English](https://github.com/wingoflan/dsh-subagent-marker/blob/main/README.en.md) | [中文](https://github.com/wingoflan/dsh-subagent-marker/blob/main/README.md)

dsh-subagent-marker README · 功能：- 只在当前会话是子代理时渲染标记。主会话不渲染任何东西，工具行保持原来的布局和间距。

一次性子代理和父会话离线的子代理，DSH 会用只读输入区替换整个工具行。标记在这两种会话里不出现，这两种会话本来也无法输入。

dsh-subagent-marker README · 安装：手动安装：

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-subagent-marker
```

从本地目录安装：

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subagent-marker
```

dsh-subagent-marker README · 开关：安装时会应用插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`。想关掉，往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 加一行覆盖：

```yaml
- id: subagent-marker
  disabled: true
```

profile 层在所有 bundle 层之后应用，不带 `insert` 的补丁按 id 覆盖已有条目，所以这一行能改到 bundle 插入的那一行。删掉它就恢复显示。

不要在 profile 层重复写 `insert` 段。同 id 的两个条目都会挂载，标记会注册两次。

dsh-subagent-marker README · 卸载：先删掉 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里的覆盖行，再执行：

```bash
dsh plugin remove dsh-subagent-marker
```

dsh-subagent-marker README · 实现：包分两半。`index.js` 是 Host 半部，只导出一个空的 `apply()`。看得见的东西全在 `client.js`：`package.json` 声明了 `dsh.client` 并导出 `./client`，Host 据此把它投递给页面。

`client.js` 往 `conversation.input.right` 槽注册一个条目。这个槽是 list 类型，位于输入框底部工具行右侧的控制区，在模型选择器旁边、停止和发送按钮之前。组件从会话快照取 `subagent`，主会话为 `null` 时返回 `null`，DOM 里不新增节点。
dsh-subagent-marker README · 开发：没有构建步骤。`exports["./client"]` 直接指向 `client.js`，改这个文件就是改投递内容。首次安装后重启一次 Host 才会加载新包。

dsh-subagent-marker README · dsh-subagent-marker：**Marks the composer of a subagent session in DeepSeek Harness.**

A subagent session's composer looks exactly like a root session's. This plugin adds a `subagent` marker at the right end of the composer's tool row, just before the submit button, so you can tell which one you are typing into.

[English](https://github.com/wingoflan/dsh-subagent-marker/blob/main/README.en.md) | [中文](https://github.com/wingoflan/dsh-subagent-marker/blob/main/README.md)

dsh-subagent-marker README · What it does：- Renders the marker only when the open session is a subagent. Root sessions get nothing, so the row keeps its original layout and spacing.

One-shot subagents and subagents whose parent went offline get a read-only composer from DSH, which replaces the whole tool row. The marker does not appear there; those sessions cannot accept input anyway.

dsh-subagent-marker README · Install：Manually:

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-subagent-marker
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subagent-marker
```

dsh-subagent-marker README · Turning it off and on：Installing applies the plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`. To switch it off, add one override row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: subagent-marker
  disabled: true
```

The profile layer is applied after every bundle layer, and a patch without `insert` overrides the entry with that id — so this one row reaches the row the bundle inserted. Deleting it switches the marker back on.

dsh-subagent-marker README · Turning it off and on：Do not repeat the `insert` block in the profile layer. Two entries with the same id both mount, and the marker would then register its slot entry twice.

dsh-subagent-marker README · Uninstall：Delete the override row from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, then:

```bash
dsh plugin remove dsh-subagent-marker
```

dsh-subagent-marker README · How it works：The package has two halves. `index.js` is the Host half and exports an empty `apply()`. Everything visible lives in `client.js`, which the Host serves to the page because `package.json` declares `dsh.client` and exports `./client`.

dsh-subagent-marker README · How it works：`client.js` registers one entry into the `conversation.input.right` slot — a list slot in the right control cluster of the composer tool row, next to the model selector and before the stop and submit buttons. The component reads `subagent` from the session snapshot and returns `null` on a root session, so nothing is added to the DOM.

dsh-subagent-marker README · Development：There is no build step. `exports["./client"]` points straight at `client.js`, so editing that file is editing what the browser receives. The first install needs a Host restart before the new package loads.
